s.note: cooked on a hot stomach, we used a pan
s.how: Toast 12 small rounds of brioche. Fry 4 rashers of bacon until crisp and break into pieces. Fry 12 quail eggs in 30g butter for a minute. Put an egg and a bit of bacon on each round and sprinkle with chives.

s.note: that call sign was always a bad idea
s.how: Cut 1kg potatoes into thick chips and fry at 140C for 6 minutes, rest, then at 185C until crisp. Whisk 1 yolk, 1 crushed garlic clove and lemon juice, then drip in 200ml oil until thick. Salt the chips and serve with the aioli.

m.note: the pilots' cook-up on the flight line
m.how: Grill 4 rib eyes and 4 corn cobs over high heat. Shred a quarter cabbage and 2 carrots and toss with 100g mayo, 2 tbsp cider vinegar, a pinch of sugar and salt. Rest the steaks 5 minutes and serve with the corn and slaw.

w.how: Line a 12-hole muffin tray with rounds cut from 2 sheets sweet shortcrust and blind-bake. Whisk 3 eggs, 250ml milk, 125ml cream and 80g sugar. Fill the cases, grate nutmeg on top and bake at 150C for 20 minutes until just set.

d.how: Put four glasses in the freezer for 30 minutes until frosted. Chill eight 355ml bottles of American lager. Pour into the frosted glasses and salute anyone who comes through the door.
